orgPolicy.title: Organization two-factor requirement
orgPolicy.description: Require every member of your organization to set up two-factor authentication.
orgPolicy.switchLabel: Require two-factor authentication for all members
orgPolicy.confirmDescription: Every member without two-factor gets a 7-day window to enroll and is emailed now. After the deadline they must set it up before they can continue using the app.
orgPolicy.enabledToast: Two-factor is now required for your organization
orgPolicy.updateFailed: Could not update the two-factor policy

enroll.passwordHint: Confirm your password to begin setting up two-factor authentication.
enroll.scanHint: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll.codesHint: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator, and they will not be shown again.

enrollOnly.hint: Your organization now requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue, or sign out.
enrollOnly.logoutFailed: Could not log out. Please try again.
enrollOnly.pageDescription: Your organization requires a second factor to continue

graceBanner.title: Two-factor authentication is required for your organization.
graceBanner.deadline: Set it up before {{date}} to keep your access.
graceBanner.noDeadline: Set it up soon to keep your access.

disable.title: Disable two-factor authentication?
disable.description: Your account will be protected by its password alone. Every recovery code is invalidated and every trusted browser is forgotten. You can turn it back on at any time. Enter your password and a current code to confirm.

regenerate.title: Regenerate recovery codes
regenerate.descriptionForm: This replaces all of your existing recovery codes. Enter your password to continue.
regenerate.descriptionCodes: Save these codes now. Your old codes no longer work.

challenge.heading: Two-factor authentication
challenge.descriptionTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
challenge.descriptionRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you received during setup. Each code works only once.
challenge.hintTotp: The code in the app changes every 30 seconds.
challenge.hintRecovery: Recovery codes use the XXXX-XXXX format. A used code is invalidated after you sign in.
challenge.toggleToTotp: Enter the code from the app
challenge.sessionExpired: Your login session expired. Please sign in again.
challenge.codeIncorrect: That code was not correct. Check your authenticator and try again.

members.title: Members
members.description: Manage member accounts: roles, lockouts, two-factor and account deletion.
members.loadError: Failed to load the member list

resetDialog.title: Reset two-factor for this member?
resetDialog.description: This wipes the two-factor setup for {{email}}, forgets their trusted browsers, and signs them out. They must enroll a new authenticator the next time they sign in.
resetDialog.error: Could not reset two-factor for this member

changeRoleDialog.title: Change this member's role?
changeRoleDialog.description: The role of {{email}} will change from "{{currentRole}}" to "{{nextRole}}". The member is signed out and the new role applies from their next sign-in.

unlockDialog.title: Unlock this account?
unlockDialog.description: The account {{email}} is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Unlocking clears the lockout so the member can sign in again right away.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this account?
deleteDialog.description: This deletes the account of {{email}} entirely, not just its membership in this organization. The member is signed out immediately. This cannot be undone.

inviteDialog.title: Invite someone to the organization
inviteDialog.description: We will send a set-password link to this address. The invitation lasts 7 days and works once.
inviteDialog.roleUserHint: Day-to-day work in the app. No account management or organization settings.
inviteDialog.roleAdminHint: Everything above, plus inviting people, changing roles and organization settings.
inviteDialog.undelivered: The account was created but the message to {{email}} could not be sent. They cannot request a new link themselves, so send the invitation again.

removeDialog.title: Remove this person from the organization?
removeDialog.description: {{email}} loses access to the organization and is signed out immediately. Their account and history stay, and you can restore them at any time.
removeDialog.error: Could not remove them from the organization

restoreDialog.title: Restore this person to the organization?
restoreDialog.description: {{email}} regains access to the organization in the role they held before.

revokeInviteDialog.title: Withdraw this invitation?
revokeInviteDialog.description: The link sent to {{email}} stops working and the unused invitation is deleted. This cannot be undone, but you can invite them again.

withdrawInviteByEmailDialog.title: Withdraw an invitation by email address?
withdrawInviteByEmailDialog.description: For an invitation sent to someone who already has an account in another organization. Such an invitation does not appear in the members table, so it is withdrawn by address. Invitations shown in the table are withdrawn from that person's row menu.
withdrawInviteByEmailDialog.consequence: The invitation link stops working. Their account in their current organization is left as it is. This cannot be undone, but you can invite them again.
withdrawInviteByEmailDialog.success: If an invitation to this organization was pending for {{email}}, it has been withdrawn.
